reveal-indicator-collapsed.$description: Transform applied to a reveal indicator while its content is collapsed.

reveal-indicator-expanded.$description: Transform applied to a reveal indicator while its content is expanded.

reveal-indicator-origin.$description: Transform origin used by reveal indicators as they change state.

identity.$description: Identity transform with no visual translation, rotation, or scaling.

quarter-turn-clockwise.$description: One clockwise quarter-turn around the configured transform origin.

origin-center.$description: Transform origin at the visual center of an element.
